reason: A DSH status-bar dashboard that visualizes per-session token usage and estimated costs, with periodic refresh and a low-balance alert based on an external balance request.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH 底部状态栏展示按会话汇总的 DeepSeek token 用量、估算花费和余额告警。
summaries.en: Displays per-session DeepSeek token usage, estimated costs, and low-balance alerts in the DSH bottom status bar.

capabilities: Reads DSH token usage and session statistics from projection caches
Aggregates and displays estimated token costs and session rankings
Refreshes dashboard data periodically and on user request
Uses DEEPSEEK_API_KEY to request account balance information
Displays a low-balance alert in the DSH status bar
